translations.en: The instant you pushed that shape into the recess,
a dazzling light burst from the inverted triangular hole.
What? What's happening?!
When the light faded, a single jar
sat inside the inverted triangular hole.
This must be the jar that grants any wish!
Before you could stop her, @7rFiore@0r pounced on the jar
and flung its lid open.
You stacked the three small triangles and pushed them into the recess.
Naturally, that did not make one large triangle,
so nothing happened.
We just have to make a triangle,
so shouldn't they go like this?
@7rFiore@0r picked up the small triangles
and began fitting them into the recess.
You deliberately took a bite of a small triangle.
Your teeth hurt.
The tablet was incredibly hard,
considering how easily it had shattered.
What are you doing?
@7rFiore@0r stared at you coldly.
The instant the jar's lid opened,
inky black smoke came billowing out.
Monster in the Jar
Ha ha ha ha ha ha!
How many centuries has it been since I was free?!
My name is @7rPluton@0r! Girl, you have my thanks for releasing me.
You're the genie who grants wishes as a reward
for being let out of the jar, right?
Pluton
No.
Huh?
I am @7rPluton@0r, the demon king sealed within this jar!
Why should one as noble as I grant the wishes
of a little girl like you?
B-but that's what the rumors said!
That you'd grant any wish!
Ah, that...
Y-you remember now?
That's the deal, right? Right? Right? Right?
That was a lie.
Whaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaat?!!!
I know not why, but recently I have been able to exert some influence
on the outside world...
I simply manipulated some foolish thieves into spreading that rumor.
S-so... I was...
A thoroughly pitiful fool who swallowed the rumors of witless thieves
and set me free.
Grrrr! I'm so mad!
Hey, would you take this @7rPluton@0r character
and beat the living daylights out of them?!
Honestly, why did something like that have to come back?!
The reason the imprisoned @7rPluton@0r had been able to act
was probably that the disappearance of @7rChu Lu Gah@0r's seals
had affected it.
Then, when we're protecting the last seal,
there was a chance this thing could have revived and gotten in our way?
@7rFiore@0r's theory was certainly a possibility.
To keep something like this from interfering as you protected the final seal,
perhaps you had been right to defeat it here.
Well, at least the trip wasn't a total waste, then...
But I still didn't get to be the savior!
You calmed @7rFiore@0r as she stamped her feet in frustration,
then set off back to the tavern.
You arrived before an eerie painting
of a burning hut.
It seemed to have been painted directly onto the wall,
rather than on a canvas or another such surface.
Hurry up and throw water on that painting.
Following @7rLady Marbas@0r's instructions, you splashed water on it.
The flames in the painting went out,
then the painting itself slowly faded, revealing a gaping hollow.
Inside lay a thick, leather-bound book.
You obtained the "@3rBook of Keys@0r."
I see you've found the @3rBook of Keys@0r.
Now, would you be so kind as to hand it over?
You turned at the unexpected voice
to find several demons staring at you with blazing eyes.
My name is @7rAnneberg@0r.
Take my advice. Give me that book.
